topics.name: Instance Configuration Ownership
topics.purpose: Define which configuration fields belong to the AIGMos instance configuration layer versus IAM, AccessCore, listeners, UserModules and protocol-specific owners.

semantics.ownership_rule: Instance config stores refs/bindings to other owners rather than copying their semantic models.
semantics.edit_rule: Instance Editor mutates only instance-owned fields directly.
semantics.separation_rule: Runtime state is not persisted as authoritative definition unless explicitly modeled as config.
semantics.authority_rule: Config ownership does not imply user authorization.

invariants.rule: AIGMos instance identity, configuration, IAM parent, AccessCore parent and runtime state remain explicit separate dimensions; configuration never silently changes semantic ownership or authority.

hard_gates.condition: instance config duplicates AccessCore policy model
instance config owns IAM credential secrets
Port Editor semantics copied into instance config
runtime state serialized as authoritative config silently
